mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_inputs ( USER_ID, TAX_YEAR, BUSINESS_REGISTERED, AGE, STARTUP_RELIEF_APPLIED, BUSINESS_REGION, DEPENDENT_COUNT, DONATION_AMOUNT, SAVE_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{taxYear}, #{businessRegistered}, #{age}, #{startupReliefApplied}, #{businessRegion}, #{dependentCount}, #{donationAmount}, #{saveStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT TAX_INPUT_ID, USER_ID, TAX_YEAR, BUSINESS_REGISTERED, AGE, STARTUP_RELIEF_APPLIED, BUSINESS_REGION, DEPENDENT_COUNT, DONATION_AMOUNT, SAVE_STATUS FROM tax_inputs WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId}

SELECT TAX_INPUT_ID, USER_ID, TAX_YEAR, BUSINESS_REGISTERED, AGE, STARTUP_RELIEF_APPLIED, BUSINESS_REGION, DEPENDENT_COUNT, DONATION_AMOUNT, SAVE_STATUS FROM tax_inputs WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tax_inputs SET USER_ID = #{userId}, TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}, BUSINESS_REGISTERED = #{businessRegistered}, AGE = #{age}, STARTUP_RELIEF_APPLIED = #{startupReliefApplied}, BUSINESS_REGION = #{businessRegion}, DEPENDENT_COUNT = #{dependentCount}, DONATION_AMOUNT = #{donationAmount}, SAVE_STATUS = #{saveStatus}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_transactions ( TAX_INPUT_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRANSACTION_DATE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, PRE_TAX_INCOME, DEDUCTED_TAX_RATE, AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{taxInputId}, #{transactionType}, #{transactionDate}, #{description}, #{category}, #{preTaxIncome}, #{deductedTaxRate}, #{amount} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRANSACTION_ID, TAX_INPUT_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRANSACTION_DATE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, PRE_TAX_INCOME, DEDUCTED_TAX_RATE, AMOUNT FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} ORDER BY TRANSACTION_ID

SELECT TRANSACTION_ID, TAX_INPUT_ID, TRANSACTION_TYPE, TRANSACTION_DATE, DESCRIPTION, CATEGORY, PRE_TAX_INCOME, DEDUCTED_TAX_RATE, AMOUNT FROM tax_transactions WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId} AND TRANSACTION_ID = #{transactionId}
SELECT TAX_INPUT_ID, RESULT_DETAIL, CALCULATED_AT FROM tax_results WHERE TAX_INPUT_ID = #{taxInputId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_process_logs ( TAX_INPUT_ID, USER_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, STATUS, FAIL_REASON ) VALUES ( #{taxInputId}, #{userId}, #{processType}, #{status}, #{failReason} )
